title: Canonical key aliases
description: How a source's spelling of a key reaches a canonical key (R22, D84, D85). `tokens` rewrites one word of a folded spelling to another (VOL to VOLUME), and `aliases` lists, per canonical id, spellings that mean it. A spelling is compared after folding (case, KEY_ and BTN_ prefixes, punctuation, + and - signs, `tokens`, spaces), so `Vol +`, `VOL+` and `KEY_VOL_PLUS` are one entry. Two spellings of different ids that fold alike, or one spelling listed twice, are errors, so a spelling means exactly one key. Versioned with keys.json.

tokens.description: Word to word, both already in folded form (upper case, no separators).

aliases.description: Canonical id to the spellings that mean it, besides the id and display name themselves.
